This policy describes how the Star Wars CCG Wiki handles information when you read, edit, or create an account on the wiki.

== Accounts and contributions ==

Anyone can read the wiki. An account is required to edit. When you register, you choose a username and password. You may also provide an email address or a name. Your email address does not appear in public edit history. Use a username you are comfortable showing publicly.

Your username, edits, edit summaries, discussion posts, and uploaded files can appear in public histories or logs. A later edit may leave an earlier version available in the page history. Check what you write or upload for personal information before saving.

== Cookies and technical records ==

The wiki uses cookies to manage sessions, including while you sign in or create an account. Web servers log requests for operation and security. Those records can include an IP address, the time and URL of a request, the browser's identifying information, and the referring page. MediaWiki can also record IP addresses in its recent-change and abuse-prevention records. Public edit histories for registered contributors identify edits by username.

The wiki serves its interface scripts and styles from this site. It uses no third-party analytics, tracking scripts, externally hosted fonts, or session replay. External sites have their own privacy practices.

== Contact ==

For privacy questions or to ask that an account be removed, email [mailto:swccg.contact@proton.me swccg.contact@proton.me]. <!-- email-ok: public role contact for privacy and takedown, Bill 2026-11-08 #102 -->
